'''Tholoth''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Tholoth system/Legends|Tholoth system]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].
{{Planet-stub}}

==History==
Tholoth was inhabited by a [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[Tholothian/Legends|Tholothians]]; they often wore distinctive [[Tholoth headdress/Legends|Tholoth headdresses]].

During the [[Galactic War]], several [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] adults inexplicably turned homicidal.<ref name="crewskill">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Tholothian Massacres}}</ref>

==Known members==
[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] was Tholothian, as well as [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]]. [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] was of Tholothian descent though raised on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
